name: Air-Fryer Okra and Chickpea Fries
ingredients: 250 g okra, washed, dried and halved lengthways
½ cup cooked chickpeas, patted dry
½ tsp each chilli powder, cumin powder and amchur
Salt, lemon juice and chaat masala
steps: Toss the okra and chickpeas with the oil, then with the besan and spices until lightly coated.
Cook in a single layer for 12–15 minutes, shaking at 6 minutes, until the okra is crisp and the chickpeas crunchy.
Finish with chaat masala and lemon juice.
note: Dry okra well before cooking; the besan coating also absorbs surface moisture.
